description.notes: The interest rate information published in this release is provided for informational purposes only. In particular, the rate information is not administered to International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) standards and is not intended to be referenced in contracts. Missing values in this series represent observation periods in which either no trading took place or in which disclosure edits were applied to protect business-confidential information.
